# ZeroTouch Support

> Independent, hands-researched reviews of customer support, business phone and AI voice software. 28 full reviews live here as the canonical version; prices are read on the vendor's page and dated. Last updated 2026-09-08.

AIBuilder Marketplace and its sister sites are run by Daniel Haket, a former banker. Every price is read on the vendor's own page and dated; every review says who should skip the tool. Affiliate links never change a verdict. Six sites, one owner.

- [Cost-trap atlas](https://zerotouchsupport.com/atlas.html): every tool in this niche with its documented pricing traps

- [Straight answers](https://zerotouchsupport.com/answers.html): is it worth it, what does it really cost, what is the catch — per tool
- [Tool finder](https://zerotouchsupport.com/finder.html): pick a tool in under a minute

## Reviews (28) — canonical versions
- [800.com Review (2026): From $19/mo, Checked Aug 2026](https://zerotouchsupport.com/800-com-review.html): 800.com — On yearly billing: Startup $19/mo, Small Business $49/mo and Complete $99/mo. The 1,000-minute cap on Startup matters for higher call volume
- [Aircall Review (2026): From $30/mo, Checked Aug 2026](https://zerotouchsupport.com/aircall-review.html): Aircall: Essentials is $30 per license a month and Professional $50, both on annual billing. 'Unlimited calling' covers listed regions — check yours.
- [Answering Service Care Review (2026): Price & Limits](https://zerotouchsupport.com/answering-service-care-review.html): Answering Service Care: $161, $296 and $575 for the three larger plans. Do the arithmetic before you pick a tier, because their own page does not.
- [Calilio Review (2026): $12 a Seat, Calls Meter Apart](https://zerotouchsupport.com/calilio-review.html): Calilio: Standard $15 per user/mo, or $12 billed annually ($144 a year). The subscription is the platform, not the talking.
- [CallHippo Review (2026): Free Tier, Then €19/mo](https://zerotouchsupport.com/callhippo-review.html): CallHippo: The same grid read in dollars on 19 July 2026 showed $19, $30 and $42. 'Unlimited calling' is unlimited to the US and Canada.
- [CloudTalk Review (2026): From €19/mo, Checked Aug 2026](https://zerotouchsupport.com/cloudtalk-review.html): CloudTalk: Lite €19, Starter €25, Essential €29 and Expert €49 per user/mo on annual billing. The per-seat price is only part of it.
- [Cloze Review (2026): 25 Free Chats, Then $49/mo](https://zerotouchsupport.com/cloze-review.html): Cloze: Free forever with 50 conversations a month, Pro $29 a month and Business $79 a month. The second is the track record, or the absence of one.
- [CometChat Review (2026): Free to 100 Users, Then $239/mo](https://zerotouchsupport.com/cometchat-review.html): CometChat — Billed yearly, shown as a monthly equivalent: at 1,000 MAU Basic is $239 and Advanced $359. The pricing cliff is the honest headline.
- [CrankWheel Review (2026): Free Tier, Then $29/mo](https://zerotouchsupport.com/crankwheel-review.html): CrankWheel: A free plan with no payment details required. If you want an all-purpose meeting platform, this isn't it.
- [eDesk Review (2026): Free Tier, Then $39/mo](https://zerotouchsupport.com/edesk-review.html): eDesk: Free plan to start; Essential $39 per agent/mo, Growth $89 (recommended), Professional $119, Enterprise custom.
- [Freshworks Review (2026): The Pricing Page Has No Prices](https://zerotouchsupport.com/freshworks-review.html): Freshworks — On Freshdesk the annual rates are unchanged since 1 August 2026: Growth $19 per agent per month, Pro $55, Enterprise $89, billed annually
- [HelpCenter Review (2026): From $5.99/mo, Checked Aug 2026](https://zerotouchsupport.com/helpcenter-review.html): HelpCenter: Free covers 10 tickets a month and charges $0.25 for each one after that. The free tier is the hook and the FAQ builder is the reason peop
- [Kixie Review (2026): No Seat Price, and Minutes Bill Apart](https://zerotouchsupport.com/kixie-review.html): Kixie: No seat price is published. Plan for 30-60% above the sticker: minutes, the multi-line dialer and AI human-voice-detection all bill separately.
- [KrispCall Review (2026): $12/mo Seats Yearly + Pay-Per-Call](https://zerotouchsupport.com/krispcall-review.html): KrispCall: Essential $12 per user/mo billed annually or $15 monthly, for solo agents and teams up to 5 people. Same honest math as most budget VoIP.
- [Lucrovox Review (2026): $199 Buys 100 AI Calls a Month](https://zerotouchsupport.com/lucrovox-review.html): Lucrovox: The phone agent has three published tiers and the plan table is back on the page. The ‘callers can’t tell it’s AI’ claim is the vendor’s own
- [Quo Review (2026): Telecom Taxes in 16 States](https://zerotouchsupport.com/quo-review.html): Quo: Business $23 annual ($276/yr) or $33 monthly. Call reliability is the recurring complaint — G2 logs hundreds of connection and disconnection repo
- [Readymode Review (2026): iQ Halves the Cost Per Number](https://zerotouchsupport.com/readymode-review.html): Readymode — Two published plans, priced per license per month: Starter $239 for 1+ licenses and iQ $299. The per-seat price is premium.
- [respond.io Review (2026): From $79/mo, Checked Aug 2026](https://zerotouchsupport.com/respond-io-review.html): respond.io — Four tiers, billed on monthly active contacts rather than seats: Starter $79/month, Growth $159, Advanced $279, and Enterprise on quote.
- [Ruby Review (2026): Real Pricing, Real Limits](https://zerotouchsupport.com/ruby-review.html): Ruby: $5.00 a minute at the bottom, $3.45 at the top. You're paying premium rates for real human receptionists billed per minute.
- [Salesmsg Review (2026): Calls Eat the Text Credits](https://zerotouchsupport.com/salesmessage-review.html): Salesmsg — Monthly billing: Basic is $25 a month for 500 credits a month; Pro is $329 a month for 10,000 credits a month. Size the credits, not the he
- [Signal House Review (2026): 500 Numbers Cost Less Than 499](https://zerotouchsupport.com/signal-house-review.html): Signal House: Usage-based, no platform subscription. The product is sold as an SMS and Voice API and the pricing page publishes no voice rate at all.
- [StoreFAQ Review (2026): Success Costs You Page Views](https://zerotouchsupport.com/storefaq-review.html): StoreFAQ: Enterprise $49.99 a month or $479.90 a year, a 20% saving. The meter is FAQ page views, and that is the thing this app exists to increase.
- [SupportBee Review (2026): From $20/mo, Checked Aug 2026](https://zerotouchsupport.com/supportbee-review.html): SupportBee: Month to month, Startup is $20/seat/month and Enterprise is $25/seat/month. Enterprise is listed as everything in Startup plus five named 
- [Tidio Review (2026): Free Tier, Then $29/mo](https://zerotouchsupport.com/tidio-review.html): Tidio: The free plan carries 50 billable conversations, 100 Flows visitors reached and 50 Lyro AI conversations.
- [Vida AI Review (2026): 30 Cents a Voice Minute](https://zerotouchsupport.com/vida-ai-review.html): Vida AI: Verify current tiers with sales. The universal truth of voice AI: demo calls are rehearsed, your callers aren't.
- [Wati Review (2026): From €59/mo, Checked Aug 2026](https://zerotouchsupport.com/wati-review.html): Wati: Growth €59/mo, Pro €119/mo and Business €279/mo billed annually, with a 7-day free trial and no setup fee.
- [Weave Review (2026): From $199 Per Location, Checked Sep 2026](https://zerotouchsupport.com/weave-review.html): Weave: Practice owners commonly report all-in costs of roughly $400 to $700 a location once phones. The $199 starting price is a floor, not the bill.
- [Zendesk Review (2026): Copilot Needs the $115 Tier](https://zerotouchsupport.com/zendesk-review.html): Zendesk — Per agent per month on annual billing, US storefront: Support Team $19, Suite Team $55, Suite Professional $115. The prices shown are annual
